name: myqsologbook
description: Logbook de QSOs offline-first com interface de linha de comando

scripts.build: spago build && spago bundle --platform node --outfile qsologbook.mjs && node tools/shebang.mjs qsologbook.mjs
scripts.manual: pandoc manual-qsologbook.md -o manual-qsologbook.pdf --pdf-engine=xelatex -V geometry:margin=2.5cm -V mainfont="DejaVu Sans" -V monofont="DejaVu Sans Mono" -V papersize=a4 --toc --toc-depth=2 -V colorlinks=true -V linkcolor=blue
